section_summary: This section documents State Department and military handling of foreign nationals’ applications, clearances, permits, and extensions for travel to occupied Japan and Okinawa in mid-1949. It includes commercial travelers, missionaries, stateless applicants, and transit passengers, together with diplomatic correspondence involving Iran, Ireland, and Thailand. A substantial reference subfile reproduces SCAP’s regulations governing the entry and exit of individuals, aircraft, and vessels.

subfiles.title: Commerce memorandum concerning Japan travel applications
subfiles.from: Michael Lee, Office of International Trade
subfiles.about: Commercial applications for travel to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Commerce transmits or discusses approved commercial travel applications for State Department processing.

subfiles.title: Telegram action-copy routing sheet
subfiles.about: Administrative routing of a telegram action copy.
subfiles.summary: Fragmentary action-copy sheet records telegram routing and filing information.

subfiles.title: Action slip for the Grigorieff family
subfiles.about: Clearance status of stateless travelers Vladimir Grigorieff and family.
subfiles.summary: Notes prior Taipei clearance and closure of the Grigorieff family’s cases.

subfiles.title: Interstate Trading Corporation application for Japan travel
subfiles.to: Departments of Commerce and State and SCAP
subfiles.about: Application for a stateless representative to conduct commercial business in Japan.
subfiles.summary: The firm seeks a sixty-day commercial visit to Tokyo, Kobe, and Yokohama to complete transactions requiring personal representation.

subfiles.title: File note on unanswered Strauss speedletter
subfiles.about: Absence of a reply from Johanna Strauss.
subfiles.summary: Records that no reply was received to the July 19, 1949 speedletter.

subfiles.title: Speedletter to Johanna Strauss
subfiles.from: Walter J. Marx, Department of State
subfiles.about: Procedure for extending her visitor’s permit in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Explains that Strauss’s Japanese sponsor must request an extension from SCAP, whose decision will pass through military and State channels.

subfiles.title: Memorandum for the files on Strauss permit procedure
subfiles.about: Consultation with the Army about Johanna Strauss’s permit extension.
subfiles.summary: Records Martin’s advice that Strauss’s sponsor should request the extension from SCAP.

subfiles.title: Letter transmitting Mrs. Rothschild’s military permit
subfiles.about: Issuance of a military permit for entry into Japan.
subfiles.summary: Encloses Mrs. Rothschild’s military permit and advises that United States exit-permit requirements have been waived.

subfiles.title: Request for action on Mrs. Rothschild’s application
subfiles.from: Walter J. Marx, Department of State
subfiles.about: Mrs. Rothschild’s request to accompany her husband to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Forwards supporting correspondence and asks the Army to determine whether a military permit can be issued.

subfiles.title: Mervin Rothschild letter requesting his wife’s permit
subfiles.about: Request for permission allowing his wife to travel with him to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Rothschild submits a Tokyo host’s letter and requests prompt clearance before his August 5 departure.

subfiles.title: Hazel Zimmerman lodging assurance
subfiles.about: Offer of accommodation in Tokyo.
subfiles.summary: Zimmerman assures Mrs. Rothschild that she may stay at the Zimmermans’ Tokyo home.

subfiles.title: Tientsin telegram requesting current Japan-entry procedure
subfiles.about: Entry requirements for passengers traveling from China through Japanese ports.
subfiles.summary: Requests updated procedures for travelers landing in Japan or transferring there to transportation bound for the United States.

subfiles.title: Letter transmitting Edwin von Vogter’s permit
subfiles.from: Walter J. Marx, Department of State
subfiles.about: Military permit 1672 for entry into Japan.
subfiles.summary: Encloses permit 1672, requests passport details, and notes the blanket waiver of United States exit permits.

subfiles.title: Townshend permit transmittal memorandum
subfiles.about: Return of Lawrence Townshend’s Japan and Okinawa permits.
subfiles.summary: Transmits permits 1638 and 1639 for Lawrence N. Townshend.

subfiles.title: Request to alter Townshend’s clearance dates
subfiles.from: Walter J. Marx, Department of State
subfiles.about: Extension of Townshend’s Japan and Okinawa entry period.
subfiles.summary: Requests new August 20–September 20 dates because business stops in Manila and Guam prevent use of the original clearance.

subfiles.title: Townshend request for revised permit dates
subfiles.about: Changing the validity dates of his Japan and Okinawa permits.
subfiles.summary: Townshend asks that both permits remain valid through September 20 because he cannot arrive by the original deadline.

subfiles.title: Return of Townshend’s extended permits
subfiles.about: Return of permits 1638 and 1639 with extended validity.
subfiles.summary: Returns Townshend’s Japan and Okinawa permits after their validity was extended as requested.

subfiles.title: Army memorandum extending Richard William Abbotts’s clearance
subfiles.about: Extension of Abbotts’s Japan-entry clearance.
subfiles.summary: Extends London-based Richard William Abbotts’s original entry clearance through September 25, 1949.

subfiles.title: Registered-mail return receipt fragment
subfiles.about: Postal evidence associated with registered correspondence.
subfiles.summary: Fragmentary registered-mail return-receipt card.

subfiles.title: B. D’Elia & Son envelope
subfiles.about: Envelope for correspondence concerning Enrico D’Elia.
subfiles.summary: Postmarked business envelope from B. D’Elia & Son.

subfiles.title: Request for Enrico D’Elia’s military permit
subfiles.about: Final approval and delivery of Enrico D’Elia’s Japan permit.
subfiles.summary: The firm reports Commerce approval and asks that D’Elia’s military permit be mailed to its New York office.

subfiles.title: Iranian Embassy request for Arjomandi extension
subfiles.about: Extension of Majdi Arjomandi’s expired Japan-entry permission.
subfiles.summary: Requests extension through September 26 because Arjomandi could not leave Iran during the original clearance period.

subfiles.title: Referral of Arjomandi extension request
subfiles.from: Walter F. Chappell, Department of State
subfiles.about: Iran’s request to extend Mohammed Argomandi’s Japan clearance.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the Iranian Embassy’s request and asks military authorities to extend Argomandi’s entry validity to September 26.

subfiles.title: Telegram to Bangkok announcing Ponevejsky clearance
subfiles.about: SCAP authorization for Leo G. Ponevejsky to enter Japan.
subfiles.summary: Announces Ponevejsky’s August entry clearance, sixty-day stay, photograph requirement, and substitute documentation procedure.

subfiles.title: Army clearance memorandum for Ponevejsky
subfiles.about: Japan-entry clearance for Leo Grigorievich Ponevejsky.
subfiles.summary: Clears Ponevejsky to enter Japan from Bangkok between August 1 and September 1 for sixty days.

subfiles.title: A. Ponve Co. application for Ponevejsky
subfiles.to: Departments of Commerce and State and SCAP
subfiles.about: Commercial travel application for Leo G. Ponevejsky.
subfiles.summary: The Russian representative seeks to manage Tokyo offices and expand textile and general-merchandise trade, visiting Tokyo, Nagoya, Osaka, Kyoto, and Kobe.

subfiles.title: Commerce memorandum forwarding Japan applications
subfiles.from: Michael Lee, Office of International Trade
subfiles.about: Commerce-approved commercial applications requiring SCAP approval.
subfiles.summary: Forwards a list of approved Japan-travel applicants, including Leo Grigorievich Ponevejsky.

subfiles.title: Letter transmitting Edgar Levedag’s military permit
subfiles.from: Walter F. Chappell, Department of State
subfiles.about: Military permit for September entry into Japan.
subfiles.summary: Encloses Levedag’s permit and advises that no United States exit permit is required.

subfiles.title: Army clearance memorandum for Edgar Levedag
subfiles.about: Japan-entry clearance for Edgar P. Levedag.
subfiles.summary: Clears Levedag to enter Japan between September 1 and October 1 for sixty days.

subfiles.title: John P. Herber & Co. application for Levedag
subfiles.to: Departments of Commerce and State and SCAP
subfiles.about: Commercial application for Edgar P. Levedag to visit Japan.
subfiles.summary: The Seattle firm proposes trade promotion, market investigation, representation of American manufacturers, and possible establishment of permanent Japanese branches. Planned destinations include Tokyo, Yokohama, Nagoya, Kobe, Osaka, Niigata, and Nagasaki.

subfiles.title: Bangkok telegram withholding Ponevejsky notification
subfiles.about: Delay in notifying Ponevejsky of his Japan clearance.
subfiles.summary: Bangkok withholds notification pending an advisory opinion on Ponevejsky’s immigration-visa case submitted from Shanghai.

subfiles.title: Irish Legation note for Terence Sheridan
subfiles.about: Application for Terence Sheridan to visit Japan en route to Hong Kong.
subfiles.summary: The Irish Legation forwards the Jesuit priest’s application and passport particulars, explaining his educational tour and intended return to Hong Kong.

subfiles.title: Referral of Sheridan’s application to the Army
subfiles.from: Walter F. Chappell, Department of State
subfiles.about: SCAP review of Terence Sheridan’s request to visit Japan.
subfiles.summary: Forwards Sheridan’s application and Irish Legation note, requesting theater consideration and issuance of a permit if approved.

subfiles.title: Record-copy replacement form for Yokohama telegram
subfiles.about: Replacement of a missing original action copy.
subfiles.summary: Designates the attached Yokohama telegram copy as the official record copy.

subfiles.title: Yokohama inquiry concerning the Edgar family
subfiles.about: Visitor-visa information for three British nationals formerly in Shanghai.
subfiles.summary: Requests visa information and confirmation of nonimmigrant status for S. E. Edgar, Dolores Edgar, and Mary Edgar.

subfiles.title: Duplicate record-copy notation
subfiles.about: Use of a duplicate as the record copy.
subfiles.summary: Directs that the duplicate be used as the record copy.

subfiles.title: London despatch transmitting Angela Ninetti’s application
subfiles.about: Military-permit application by Italian religious sister Angela Ninetti.
subfiles.summary: Transmits Ninetti’s application for permanent residence as a teaching sister in Japan and requests that the decision be cabled to Turin.

subfiles.title: Foreign Service Serial 667 on representing foreign interests in Japan
subfiles.about: United States transmission of Japan-entry applications for countries lacking representation there.
subfiles.summary: Explains when foreign governments may send Japan-entry applications through United States diplomatic channels for referral to SCAP.

subfiles.title: SCAP Circular 8: Control of Entry and Exit
subfiles.from: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.to: Occupation implementing agencies and foreign representatives
subfiles.about: Rules governing individuals, aircraft, and vessels entering or leaving occupied Japan.
subfiles.summary: Circular 8 establishes authorization, documentation, health, customs, entry-permit, and exit procedures for individuals traveling to occupied Japan. It separately regulates aircraft, merchant vessels, and combatant ships, including requests, routes, manifests, ports, passengers, and cargo. The Eighth Army, Pacific Air Command, and Naval Activities Japan serve as implementing agencies under SCAP oversight.

subfiles.title: Foreign Service Serial 668 on transit visas and military permission
subfiles.about: Transit-visa treatment of travelers bound for Japan.
subfiles.summary: Authorizes routine transit-visa handling when applicants present proof of SCAP clearance under Circular 8.

subfiles.title: Record-copy replacement form for Tokyo telegram 289
subfiles.about: Replacement of the missing action copy of Tokyo telegram 289.
subfiles.summary: Designates the attached Tokyo telegram copy as the record copy.

subfiles.title: Tokyo telegram concerning Mrs. Thomas C. Smith’s sailing
subfiles.about: Availability of a commercial sailing for Mrs. Thomas C. Smith.
subfiles.summary: Asks whether the President Cleveland’s early-October Yokohama arrival is the earliest sailing after Smith’s authorized September 15 entry date.

subfiles.title: Action slip extending Argomandi’s clearance
subfiles.about: Extension of Mohammad Argomandi’s Japan-entry clearance.
subfiles.summary: Extends Argomandi’s original clearance through September 26, 1949, under its existing conditions.

subfiles.title: Notification to Iran of Arjomandi’s extension
subfiles.about: Approval of Majdi Arjomandi’s requested entry extension.
subfiles.summary: Confirms that Arjomandi may enter Japan through September 26 under the conditions of his original clearance.

subfiles.title: Army request for Apostolic assurances for Sheridan
subfiles.about: Additional support documentation for Terence Sheridan.
subfiles.summary: States that Sheridan must provide Apostolic Delegation assurances before a military permit can issue.

subfiles.title: Apostolic Delegation envelope to Chappell
subfiles.about: Envelope carrying missionary-support correspondence.
subfiles.summary: Special-delivery envelope addressed to Chappell at the Division of Protective Services.

subfiles.title: Apostolic assurance for Terence Sheridan
subfiles.about: Support and conduct assurances for Sheridan’s missionary entry.
subfiles.summary: Recommends Sheridan and assures that he will burden neither Japan nor occupation forces and will avoid unauthorized activities.

subfiles.title: File note on obtaining Sheridan’s Apostolic letter
subfiles.about: Coordination of Sheridan’s supporting letter and permit delivery.
subfiles.summary: Records contacts with the Irish Legation and instructions for forwarding and collecting Sheridan’s permit.

subfiles.title: Transmittal of Sheridan’s Apostolic assurances
subfiles.from: Walter F. Chappell, Department of State
subfiles.about: Supporting letter for Terence Sheridan’s application.
subfiles.summary: Forwards two signed copies of the Apostolic Delegation’s August 13 letter in response to the Army’s request.

subfiles.title: Mrs. Rothschild’s airmail envelope
subfiles.about: Envelope containing a question about her military permit.
subfiles.summary: Airmail envelope sent from San Francisco to the Department of State.

subfiles.title: Mrs. Rothschild letter about arrival dates
subfiles.about: Whether her existing permit covers a late-August arrival in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges receipt of her permit and asks whether it must be extended for her planned August 26 or 28 departure.

subfiles.title: Reply concerning Mrs. Rothschild’s permit validity
subfiles.from: Walter F. Chappell, Department of State
subfiles.about: Whether an extension of her Japan-entry permit is necessary.
subfiles.summary: Advises that no extension is needed because the permit remains valid until October 1, unless her circumstances change substantially.

subfiles.title: Apostolic assurance for Daniel Carrigan
subfiles.about: Recommendation of Daniel Carrigan as a Catholic missionary to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Assures that Carrigan will burden neither Japan nor occupation forces and will avoid unauthorized activities.

subfiles.title: Army letter requesting Carrigan’s support assurance
subfiles.about: Documentation required for Carrigan’s military-permit request.
subfiles.summary: Instructs Carrigan to obtain Apostolic Delegation assurances and submit them through the Division of Protective Services.

subfiles.title: Referral of Carrigan’s missionary application
subfiles.from: Walter F. Chappell, Department of State
subfiles.about: Application and support assurances for Daniel Carrigan.
subfiles.summary: Forwards Carrigan’s application and letters from the Apostolic Delegate and his missionary society, requesting return of any issued permit.

subfiles.title: Commerce memorandum on Maneck Dastur
subfiles.about: Approved Japan-travel application for Maneck N. Dastur.
subfiles.summary: Reports Commerce approval of Carrier Corporation’s Indian representative, who seeks entry on September 1.

subfiles.title: Receipt for Terence Sheridan’s military permit
subfiles.about: Receipt of military permit 1934 for Terence Sheridan.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges receipt of Sheridan’s permit for missionary entry between August 17 and October 17.

subfiles.title: Conversation memorandum on Vongse’s permit
subfiles.about: Correct documentation channel and revised dates for Phiphatana Vanij Vongse.
subfiles.summary: O’Brien and Flickinger agree that Vongse should receive documentation through Thailand and revise his clearance to September 10–October 10.

subfiles.title: Referral of Vongse’s trade application
subfiles.from: Walter F. Chappell, Department of State
subfiles.about: SCAP consideration of Phiphatana Vanij Vongse’s application.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the Thai trade traveler’s application and requests theater review and issuance of a military permit if approved; page 391 is blank.

subfiles.title: Thai Embassy note submitting Vongse’s application
subfiles.about: Permission for Phiphatana Vanij Vongse to enter Japan for trade.
subfiles.summary: Requests State Department referral of Vongse’s application to SCAP for the necessary entry permission.

subfiles.title: Instruction to deliver Ponevejsky’s clearance
subfiles.about: Delivery of Ponevejsky’s Japan clearance despite the separate visa case.
subfiles.summary: Orders Bangkok to deliver the clearance, treating Ponevejsky’s immigration-visa matter separately.

subfiles.title: File note on Ponevejsky’s visa and Japan clearance
subfiles.about: Relationship between Ponevejsky’s United States visa case and SCAP clearance.
subfiles.summary: Argues that State must transmit SCAP’s approval regardless of the separate immigration-visa decision.

subfiles.title: Interdivisional memorandum on Ponevejsky
subfiles.about: Bangkok’s delay in notifying Ponevejsky of his Japan clearance.
subfiles.summary: Requests prompt notice of the visa decision so Bangkok can act before Ponevejsky’s Japan clearance expires September 1.

subfiles.title: File note on the Ponevejsky immigration opinion
subfiles.about: Status of a recommendation to refuse Ponevejsky an immigration visa.
subfiles.summary: Records efforts to determine whether the July 11 refusal recommendation had been signed and sent.

subfiles.title: Notification to Thailand of Vongse’s clearance
subfiles.about: Approval and documentation of Phiphatana Vanij Vongse’s Japan entry.
subfiles.summary: States that Vongse may enter Japan between September 10 and October 10 for sixty days and must carry two photographs. It asks Thailand to place the required SCAP-clearance statement in his passport and encloses commercial-entry guidance.

subfiles.title: Bangkok follow-up telegram on Ponevejsky
subfiles.about: Urgent request for instructions concerning Ponevejsky’s clearance.
subfiles.summary: Reports that Ponevejsky learned of the authorization from a Tokyo associate and is pressing for official information.

subfiles.title: Receipt for Daniel Carrigan’s military permit
subfiles.about: Receipt of military permit 1960 for Daniel Carrigan.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges Carrigan’s permit for missionary entry between September 15 and November 15, 1949.
